description: This is a PHP class defining a database migration script for updating the schema and data of the OrangeHRM system to version 5.0.0. It includes methods for schema modifications, data permissions, configuration of menus, and localization updates.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Installer\Migration\V5_0_0\Migration
classes.description: Main class for performing database and configuration migration to version 5.0.0 of OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, data permissions setup, menu configurations, localization updates, and other system modifications necessary for migration to version 5.0.0.

methods.name: configureTimeMenuItemsIfTimesheetStartDateDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under the 'Time' section based on configuration value for timesheet start date.

methods.name: configureLeaveMenuItemsIfLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under the 'Leave' section based on whether leave period is defined.

methods.name: configureMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to set the status of menu items based on configuration flags.

methods.name: addTimezoneColumnsToAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Adds timezone-related columns to attendance records and updates their values based on predefined timezone map.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class for specific modules and screens.

methods.name: updateModuleDisplayNames
methods.description: Updates display names for various modules in the system.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts or updates internationalization groups into the database.

methods.name: cleanUniqueIdTable
methods.description: Deletes entries from the unique ID table excluding those for hs_hr_employee.

methods.name: hideAddonMenuItems
methods.description: Hides specific menu items such as 'Claim' and 'LDAP Configuration'.
